limitations: Illustrative coefficients, not a national projection or nutrition prescription
Opening-of-month exposure; births and arrivals enter needs from next month
Whole-person demographic apportionment and carried mortality fractions are modelling choices
Age-only cohorts do not model sex, fertility mechanisms, pregnancy, health/disability, household choice or regional flows
Unknown care/protein/vitamin data remain missing; prospective upstream mapping covers only two component needs
The old upstream plan fails full-needs approval for new demand; accepted runtime fixture uses a declared finite water stock only
Scenario variants and need intervals are conditional assumptions, not statistical confidence bounds

definition.basis: Synthetic finite opening stock; no refill or actual water supply claim
